draft.profile: piecewise linear decision boundary: A decision boundary that consists of multiple linear segments rather than a single straight line. In multi-class classification, when linear two-class classifiers are combined using a fusion rule, the resulting decision boundary is always piecewise linear. This means that the overall classifier's decision regions are separated by a set of connected linear pieces, reflecting the combined decisions of the individual classifiers.
